method: Manual code/diff review; no /code-review tool is exposed
language_service_exception: Exact installed pyright-langserver.exe --stdio command only; all scientific/test Python remains rejected
process_model: PowerShell coordinator launches one fresh Python at a time, -X cpu_count=24. A failed arm stops the pair; never overwrite an existing state. Child scientific lock and permanent quota claims enforce isolation.
recovery: Inspect controller and child processes plus states; adopt completed arm or live child, never rerun a consumed claim. No tests during either arm.
limitations: No scientific gain before paired runs and homogeneous replay
Controller PowerShell parsed/reviewed; real execution must be monitored
R2 elapsed time48min is a planning observation, not a code speedup measurement
